text:
support-amy: Hey team — customer GammaAero (acct: GA-4321) reports their usage graphs in Console are showing zeros / stale for the last ~3.5 hours. Ticket #12345 opened at 2026-03-15 11:12 UTC. Can someone take a look?

ops-sre: I'm on it. quick glance at consumer metrics shows a big lag on the kafka consumer for topic `usage-events-15m` (group: analytics-ingest). lag: ~1.1M messages.

data-ops: seeing repeated connector errors around 2026-03-15T07:45Z: `ERROR Commit failed: Offset out of range` — looks like a consumer rebalance + retention kick? paste log snippet: ```2026-03-15T07:46:02Z ERROR Commit failed: OffsetOutOfRangeException topic usage-events-15m partition 12 offset 3401234```

ops-sre: good catch. retention might have trimmed some segments. checking broker logs and topic config now. @data-ops can you run `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka-1:9092 --describe --group analytics-ingest`?

data-ops: ran it — several partitions now show `CURRENT-OFFSET` < `LOG-END-OFFSET` by large margin, but a couple partitions show consumer group is missing offsets (consumer group lost membership during restart). output: ```TOPIC PARTITION CURRENT-OFFSET LOG-END-OFFSET LAG CONSUMER-ID
usage-events-15m 12 - 3402345 - none
usage-events-15m 23 120000 1212345 1092345 consumer-2```

ops-sre: looks like a partial rebal + retention trim caused offsets to be invalid -> consumer stalled. I bumped analytics-ingest from 2 -> 6 instances to parallelize and pulled a manual commit strategy on the stalled partitions to move to log-end so pipeline can resume ingest for new events.

eng-bot: deploy.run success — restarted analytics-ingest consumer group (6 replicas) at 2026-03-15T11:35Z.

data-ops: after restart, consumer is consuming but we still have a window of missing processed aggregates (3.5h). We should run a targeted backfill for affected tenant (GammaAero) for the missing timestamp range.

pm-zoe: Customer-facing note: GammaAero's internal dashboards are showing missing usage since 07:30Z. This is affecting their product telemetry dashboards (non-billing) and they requested ETA. Recommend P2 and send interim message.

ops-sre: launching backfill job: `./scripts/run_backfill.sh --tenant GA-4321 --topic usage-events-15m --from 2026-03-15T07:30:00Z --to 2026-03-15T11:30:00Z` returning job id `bf-7890`. Job puts events back into processing queue and triggers aggregation worker.

data-ops: backfill job queued: bf-7890. sample output: ```queued: bf-7890 events: ~430k estimated runtime: ~18m parallelism: 8```

support-amy: I updated ticket #12345 with the interim note + ETA ~25m for metrics to repopulate. Customer OK with P2.

maria: FYI — billing pipeline is downstream of the final billing-aggregator topic; this incident doesn't appear to affect billing meter data because that consumes from `billing-events` which was unaffected. I will double-check once backfill completes.

ops-sre: backfill progress: 30% at 11:55Z, 80% at 12:00Z. Aggregation workers processing ok, no further consumer errors.

data-ops: verification: spot-checked GA-4321 last-15m buckets show non-zero now. We still need to re-run one downstream summary job for the 10:00–10:15 window to fix a partial overwrite bug. Running `recompute_summary --tenant GA-4321 --window 2026-03-15T10:00:00Z/2026-03-15T10:15:00Z` now.

ops-sre: recompute finished, console charts for GammaAero are repopulated for 07:30–11:30 window. Closing immediate customer impact.

pm-zoe: Customer updated and relieved. Will follow up with a short incident note and RFC for consumer group scaling + retention config.

support-amy: Thanks everyone — I'll close the support ticket and add timeline. Please add postmortem owners.

data-ops: action items: (1) investigate why consumer lost offsets during rebalance, (2) add alert for `OffsetOutOfRangeException`, (3) add monthly run of an end-to-end backfill test, (4) doc the manual backfill steps.

ops-sre: I'll schedule a quick blameless postmortem tomorrow and link ticket. marking sev:P2 -> monitoring. :white_check_mark:

eng-bot: incident created: INC-2026-042 (assigned ops-sre, data-ops)

support-amy: Final note for the thread — duration: ~3.5h data gap, customer impact: temporary dashboard gaps for GA-4321 only, billing unaffected, mitigation: backfill job bf-7890 + recompute. Follow-ups tracked in INC-2026-042 and ticket #12345.
